name: 17972 · Schuykl Havn, PA
findings: ZIP 17972 (Schuykl Havn) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17972 (Schuykl Havn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17972 (Schuykl Havn) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
